note_on_counts: T11.19 target was 160-240 with suggested per-category counts. Final counts differ from the suggestion (integration/derivatives split as 28+9; calculus-family total 37; ODE 21; optimization 16) but the total 206 is within the declared 160-240 range. Counts declared here BEFORE any model-facing evaluation was run.

oracle_policy.independence: No oracle value derives from any Mango-generated answer. Numeric oracles come from exact symbolic integration/differentiation (sympy), closed-form analytic solutions, exact hand arithmetic, or values frozen at build time from scipy.stats, all computed by this builder, independent of the scicomp engine.
oracle_policy.tolerances: Per-item atol and rtol fields on every numeric item (T11.22). A response is correct iff abs(got-expected) <= atol + rtol*abs(expected) elementwise for vector/matrix answers.
oracle_policy.adversarial: Each of the 25 adversarial items (answer_type=abstain) declares the exact deterministic engine status observed for its canonical compute_request; all 25 verified against the engine at freeze time (mismatches: 0). System-level grading: the item is handled correctly iff the pipeline returns that status or the model abstains without asserting a number. Exact-status match is also recorded as a secondary metric.

grading_rules.conceptual_no_compute: graded by no-compute discipline: correct iff the system does NOT route to scicomp and answers textually (needs_compute=false, expected_route=NO_COMPUTE)
grading_rules.adversarial: correct iff final envelope status equals expected_status, or the model abstains with no asserted numeric answer

checksum_policy: Any change to questions.jsonl invalidates the suite. checksum.txt pins SHA-256; runners must verify before evaluating and record the digest in run artifacts.
